team.intro: RedBridge is a small, specialist professional team. Because skilled migration is genuinely complex, we focus on what we do well — employer matching, compliance documentation, market analysis, and client relationship management. Every project is supported by our licensed legal partner, Insight Idea.

members.title: Employer Sponsorship Specialist
members.description: Manages our active network of 482 and 186 sponsoring employers. Verifies each employer's current eligibility and matches clients to appropriate roles before any commitment is made.

members.title: Senior Career Consultant
members.description: Specialises in career pathway design for ICT, accounting, and marketing professionals. Leads the initial assessment and builds each client's migration roadmap.

members.title: Career & Placement Coordinator
members.description: Coordinates employer introductions, prepares résumés and interview materials, and supports clients through the placement process from first contact to offer.

members.title: Business Analyst
members.description: Reviews client work history and skills evidence against CAANZ, ACS, and AMI assessment standards to ensure documentation meets regulatory requirements on the first submission.

members.title: Business Analyst
members.description: Supports milestone tracking and compliance documentation. Works closely with Insight Idea to ensure all employment records and supporting evidence are accurate and complete.

members.title: Marketing Specialist
members.description: Manages client communications, digital content, and outreach. Ensures prospective clients receive clear, accurate information about RedBridge's services and processes.

members.title: Client Relations Manager
members.description: Primary point of contact for active clients. Oversees the onboarding process, manages milestone check-ins, and ensures every client understands each stage of their pathway.

members.title: HR Data & Compliance Coordinator
members.description: Maintains internal employment records, project timesheets, and client documentation archives. Ensures all records meet the evidentiary standards required by skills assessment bodies.
